title: Standing trading authorization: arming a strategy is the owner's standing click
lifecycle_note: Merged 2026-11-17 by the owner's click; amendment 1 (AUTO when nothing is armed, a risk-reducing Position Manager) 2026-11-17. Nothing is built on the platform side; the implementation is the xauusd repository's RFC_STRATEGY_RECOMMENDATION, measured by its strategy_arm.v1 reports.
